test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 8 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is '**right**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **most appropriate** answer is '**right**'.
 
• The **meaning **of the word '**right**' is '**true or correct as a fact**'.
 
• Hence, the appropriate word to fill in the blank is '**right**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's understand the other options.
 
 
• **Helpful**- giving or ready to give help.
 
• **Equal**- being the same in quantity, size, degree, or value.
 
• **Valid**- (of an argument or point) having a sound basis in logic or fact; reasonable or cogent.
